title: Brainstorm, plan, then a test-first subagent per task

program.def:
def card(work):
    sizes = [3, 5, 2, 4]
    steps = [['red', 'green', 'refactor', 'review']] * 3 + [['green', 'red', 'refactor', 'review']]
    size_ok, order_ok = tdd_cycle(sizes, steps)
    save(work, 'tdd.json', {'sizes': sizes, 'steps': steps})
    return [truth('tasks 2-5 min', size_ok), truth('out-of-order cycle caught', not order_ok), truth('correct cycle accepted', tdd_cycle(sizes, steps[:3])[1]), truth('12-min task rejected', not tdd_cycle([12], steps[:1])[0])]
